title: Robust Speech Recognition via Large-Scale Weak Supervision
normalization_standard: Standard Whisper English normalizer / Slavic-Devanagari loop
limitations: Complete absence of native Kashmiri token <|ks|>; severe cross-lingual hallucination.

limitations: Binary inspection confirms 0 adapter weights exist for standard Kashmiri (kas).
